title: KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.14448v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Asynchronous rollout improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by reducing under-utilization during long-tail generation. Sustained concurrency also concentrates context processing into fewer decode steps, increasing the KV workload per step. We characterize this \emph{KV concentration} and find that KV cache quantization delivers substantially greater acceleration than weight-only and weight-activation quantization in our matched-workload comparisons. However, INT4 KV rollout can degrade learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling (TIS). We propose \emph{KV4-RL}, which combines calibration-free INT4 KV quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context. Protecting a bounded number of positions reduces sampler mismatch while retaining most of the speedup from INT4. Across 400 iterations of Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO training, KV4-RL achieves $1.80\times$ cum

translated_title: KV4-RL：利用INT4 KV缓存量化为RLVR解锁更快的异步rollout
translated_abstract: 异步rollout通过减少长尾生成期间的资源闲置，提升了可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的效率。持续的并发还会将上下文处理集中到更少的解码步骤中，从而增加每一步的KV工作负载。我们对这种“KV集中”现象进行了刻画，并在匹配工作负载的对比实验中发现，KV缓存量化相比仅权重量化和权重-激活量化能带来显著更大的加速。然而，即使采用词元级截断重要性采样（TIS），INT4 KV rollout仍可能导致学习性能退化。我们提出KV4-RL，它将免校准的INT4 KV量化与对注意力汇聚点（attention sinks）和近期上下文的选择性INT8保护相结合。保护有限数量的位置可以减少采样器失配，同时保留INT4带来的大部分加速。在Qwen3-8B-Base的GRPO训练400次迭代中，KV4-RL实现了1.80倍的累计……
tldr: KV4-RL通过免校准的INT4 KV缓存量化，并对注意力汇聚点和近期上下文进行选择性INT8保护，在避免训练性能退化的同时，为RLVR异步rollout带来约1.8倍的显著加速。
en_tdlr: KV4-RL combines calibration-free INT4 KV cache quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context, achieving substantial rollout speedup for RLVR training without degrading learning.
